zh.title: 飛行員以Cessna R182在天空重現蒙娜麗莎
zh.summary: 飛行員Benjamin McDaniel駕駛Cessna R182在天空繪製蒙娜麗莎，展現一次到位飛行
body: Simple Flying於2026年10月3日報導，飛行員Benjamin McDaniel將一架Cessna R182化身為飛行畫筆，在天空中重現名畫《蒙娜麗莎》。
報導指出，此舉證明「天空藝術」需要精確的飛行技術，強調一次到位的執行力。
這項運用輕型飛機進行的藝術創作，展現了一般航空器除了運輸之外的新用途。
報導標題為「You Get One Shot」，強調此類飛行必須精準無誤。
此事件目前尚無具體日期、地點或航班細節的進一步資訊。

en.title: Pilot Benjamin McDaniel Recreates Mona Lisa in the Sky With Cessna R182
en.summary: Pilot Benjamin McDaniel turns a Cessna R182 into a flying pencil to recreate the Mona Lisa in one-shot;
body: Simple Flying reported on October 3, 2026, that pilot Benjamin McDaniel turned a Cessna R182 into a flying pencil to recreate the Mona Lisa in the sky.
The report states that this sky art demands precision and one-shot flying, emphasizing the need for accuracy in executing the aerial drawing.
This incident shows a creative use of general aviation aircraft beyond typical flying, where the Cessna R182 serves as a tool for artistic expression.
The report's title, "You Get One Shot," further underscores the requirement for a flawless execution in this type of aerial drawing.
Further details, such as the specific date, location, or any flight information, were not provided in the report.
